scope: Vietnamese-local-news wave: long-running, beloved HCMC food & drink INSTITUTIONS (the 'quán X bán suốt N năm' heritage features). Namespaced + kept SEPARATE from other HCMC source files.

outlets.name: VnExpress (Du lịch)
outlets.note: Vietnam's largest online newspaper; its Du lịch / Món ngon Sài Gòn desk runs the definitive 'bán suốt N năm' heritage-eatery features. Top-tier recommender.

outlets.name: Tuổi Trẻ
outlets.note: Major HCMC daily; heritage food features incl. the phunuonline-syndicated 'chè âm phủ' / 'cháo lòng 80 năm' pieces. Top-tier recommender.

outlets.name: Thanh Niên
outlets.note: Major national daily (HCMC); strong 'Sài Gòn tiệm xưa quán cũ' longevity series. Top-tier recommender.

outlets.name: VietnamNet
outlets.note: Major national news outlet; recurring old-Saigon street-food profiles. Top-tier recommender.

outlets.name: Dân Việt (Nông Thôn Ngày Nay)
outlets.note: National daily; 'Sài Gòn quán' heritage-eatery column. Credible recommender.

outlets.name: Người Lao Động
outlets.note: Major HCMC daily; e.g. 'Vững như cơm tấm Thuận Kiều'. Credible recommender.

outlets.name: Phụ Nữ TP.HCM
outlets.note: HCMC Women's Union newspaper; heritage food & human-interest features. Credible recommender.

outlets.name: Dân Trí
outlets.note: Major national news outlet; travel/street-food coverage. Credible corroborating recommender.

outlets.name: Kenh14
outlets.note: Large VN youth-culture outlet; long-running-eatery features (used as a corroborating recommender).

outlets.name: Znews (formerly Zing)
outlets.note: Major VN news outlet; '8 tiệm bánh mì trên 50 năm tại TP.HCM' and Ông Tạ heritage pieces. Credible recommender.

outlets.name: Sài Gòn Tiếp Thị
outlets.note: HCMC business/lifestyle publication; 'Bữa sáng Sài Gòn' heritage-eatery series. Credible recommender.

outlets.name: Style-Republik
outlets.note: VN culture/design magazine; long-form heritage feature 'Di sản ngọt ngào trong tiệm kem 70 tuổi'. Credible corroborating recommender.

outlets.name: Saigoneer
outlets.note: Leading English-language Saigon culture & street-food publication (Hẻm Gems series). Top-tier recommender.

outlets.name: Vietnam Record Organization (VietKings / Kỷ Lục Việt Nam)
outlets.note: Institutional records/awards body; its 2023 'Top 10 bánh mì lâu đời >50 năm' recognition and TOPPLUS 'Top 100 quán ngon' nominations count as a MEASURE/award authority (used only alongside a news recommender, never alone).
